 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE SANDEEP KUMAR  ORAL ORDER 4 18-12-2025 Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the State.
2. The petitioner seeks bail in connection with Complaint Case No. 559/2023 registered for the offences punishable under Sections 498A, 324/34 of the Indian Penal Code 3.
As per the prosecution case, petitioner is alleged to have tortured his wife due to non-fulfillment of dowry.
4. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that petitioner has falsely been implicated in the present case.
Learned counsel further submits that petitioner is a man with a clean antecedent and he is in custody since 01.06.2025.

The Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.69141 of 2025(4)
dt.18-12-2025 petitioner undertakes to co-operate in the case/ trial.
5. Learned APP for the State has opposed the prayer for regular bail of the petitioner.
6. Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, this application for regular bail is allowed.
